listing.description:
cApp Guide adds an integrated help and onboarding layer to applications built with cApp. Developers author the product knowledge, targets, tours, documentation and workflows that ship with the app, giving users contextual guidance without handing an AI model unrestricted control.

Guide separates the experience into Tour, This page, and Ask & tasks. It can provide deterministic help directly from authored product guidance, optionally use Local AI or an explicitly configured MCP context source, and execute only declared application actions and bounded workflows. Controller modes range from fully guided interaction to cancellable automation, while sensitive inputs, arbitrary JavaScript, arbitrary networking and model-invented selectors or commands remain outside the authority boundary.

The same Guide package runs across Windows and Android. Project development exposes authoring and preview tools inside cApp, while packaged releases suppress Admin authoring and ship the immutable user-facing Guide configuration with the application.
features: Bounded declared actions instead of unrestricted AI control
Optional Local AI and explicitly configured MCP context
listing.summary: A project-authored Guide runtime for cApp applications, combining first-time onboarding, contextual page help, AI-assisted support, voice input and declared in-app workflows.
